categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Feiliks International Logistics Inc. primarily operates in two main segments: comprehensive logistics services and international freight forwarding logistics services. Comprehensive logistics includes inbound logistics management, production logistics, finished goods logistics, land transportation and warehousing, multimodal transport, value-added services, service outsourcing, global after-sales spare parts logistics, and low-carbon green circular packaging. International freight forwarding covers sea freight, air freight, and integrated global door-to-door supply chain solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced logistics technologies such as automated handling robots, automated conveyor sorting systems, narrow aisle forklifts, non-standard automation, AI vision technology, and intelligent warehouse management systems. It also develops digital platforms including order management systems (OMS), robotic process automation (RPA), AI-powered data query assistants, and integrated customs management systems to enhance operational efficiency and service quality. The company emphasizes digital transformation with business and data middle platforms and AI applications to optimize supply chain processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Feiliks serves intelligent manufacturing enterprises, focusing on electronic information manufacturing, new energy, automotive and auto parts, photovoltaic, and other advanced manufacturing sectors. Its key customers include brand owners, manufacturers, and suppliers within these industries. The company also supports global after-sales spare parts logistics and provides tailored supply chain solutions to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with significant presence in Suzhou, Shanghai, Southwest China, and other regions. Internationally, it has a global network covering over 50 countries and regions across five continents, with strategic focus on Southeast Asia (Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore), North America (including the US and Mexico), and emerging markets such as the Middle East and Central and Eastern Europe. It maintains subsidiaries and operational bases in Hong Kong, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: Feiliks operates primarily as a midstream and downstream logistics service provider within the manufacturing supply chain. It offers integrated supply chain management, including warehousing, transportation, customs clearance, and value-added services, acting as a logistics partner to manufacturers and brand owners. The company also provides international freight forwarding services, connecting upstream suppliers and downstream customers globally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on data and technology-driven supply chain management, emphasizing digital transformation, AI integration, and green logistics. Key R&D initiatives include developing digital employee platforms (RPA), intelligent data query assistants based on large AI models, integrated customs management systems, and smart logistics solutions. It aims to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and support sustainable, low-carbon supply chains. The company also invests in expanding multimodal transport capabilities and overseas network development.
categories.revenue_model: Feiliks generates revenue primarily through service fees from comprehensive logistics services and international freight forwarding. This includes charges for warehousing, transportation, customs clearance, value-added logistics services, and integrated supply chain solutions. Revenue is recognized based on contract terms, typically upon completion of service milestones or delivery of goods. The company operates on a direct sales model with monthly billing cycles.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Feiliks is ranked among the top logistics providers in China, holding positions such as 9th in international freight forwarding logistics warehousing revenue and 12th among private international freight forwarders. It is recognized as a leading green logistics enterprise and a top 50 private logistics company in China. The company competes with other major logistics and freight forwarding firms by leveraging its integrated supply chain solutions, advanced technology adoption, and global network coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Feiliks reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.62 billion, representing a 31.69% increase from 2023. International freight forwarding revenue grew by 50.06%, and comprehensive logistics services revenue increased by 9.52%. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 11.74 million, declining 153.85% year-over-year due to increased costs and one-time transformation expenses. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.96 billion, with a slight increase from the previous year, and it maintains a broad asset base including significant warehousing and logistics infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Feiliks emphasizes its integrated, end-to-end supply chain management tailored for intelligent manufacturing industries, combining comprehensive logistics and international freight forwarding services. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced digital and automation technologies, extensive warehousing resources, global multimodal transport networks, and strong industry expertise in electronics, automotive, and new energy sectors. The company also focuses on green logistics and sustainable supply chain solutions, providing customers with cost-effective, efficient, and environmentally responsible logistics services.
